brain.commentary: Risk-on cross-asset conditions support selective exposure, but conviction is generally marginal, expected shortfall is material, and institutional advisory risk is elevated. Keep aggregate risk below normal. Fragile signals: UNI/USD has the strongest composite but very high volatility and poor liquidity; XLM/USD also combines high volatility with weak liquidity. AVAX/USD, ADA/USD, BCH/USD, and ETC/USD lack sufficient signal quality, while DOGE/USD and XRP/USD have weak alpha and liquidity support. Prefer only modest calibration toward BTC, LINK, and UNI; avoid broad altcoin risk expansion.
